test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement required’.

Newton, after seeing the apple falling from a tree, __began to wonder whether if __it moved towards the earth and not upwards towards the sky.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase ‘whether if it moved towards....’ is incorrect.
 
• The phrase ‘whether if’ is** redundant **as both words mean the same thing.
 
• We need to use **‘why’** instead of **‘whether if’** to correctly convey the meaning.
 
• The correct phrase should be **".....began to wonder why it moved towards...'**

Hence the correct statement is '***Newton, after seeing the apple falling from a tree, began to wonder why __it moved towards the earth and not upwards towards the sky*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When correcting sentences, it is crucial to **ensure** that the replacement phrase or word maintains the original meaning and context.
 
• Redundancies like **‘whether if’** should be** avoided** to make sentences clear and concise.
 
• Other options given are not appropriate in sense. 
 
• '**began to wondering if**' and '**began his wondering how'** are not correct because it don't make any sense to the sentence given and the formats for both options are not correct.
